data.cultural_impact: Falguni, being a name of Indian origin, conveys a rich cultural heritage. The name is a nod to the Indian calendar with its association to the festive month of Falgun, which falls around late February and early March. This month is celebrated with the Holi festival, marking the victory of good over evil and the arrival of spring. The lively spirit and celebratory nature of the name reflect the vibrant Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Falguni can be considered a divine name, representing the embodiment of enthusiasm, joy, and positivity. It is associated with Goddess Agni, who signifies power, strength, and transformation. The name Falguni can be a reminder to look inward, embrace the spiritual journey, and celebrate life with joy and gratitude.

historical_references.reference: Falguni is believed to be the name of the goddess of spring and love in Hinduism, identified with the Roman goddess Venus.
The name Falguni is also associated with the Hindu month of Falgun, which falls in late February or early March in the Gregorian calendar.
